recommendations.body: `_classify_existing()` in `plan_tool/roadmap_escalation_run.py` (step 4 "Map immutable-evidence storage results to redacted receipt lifecycle evidence") has two of its outcome branches — `collision` and the `final_name`/source-path mismatch arms of `invalid-existing-receipt` — with zero test coverage anywhere in the suite, despite the detail naming `test_valid_different_existing_receipt_is_collision` and the full mismatch matrix under `test_invalid_existing_receipt_has_no_handoff` as required acceptance tests
recommendations.suggested_action: extend `tests/test_roadmap_escalation_run.py` with the collision and final-name/path-mismatch cases described above

recommendations.title: `_persist_interruption()` in `plan_tool/roadmap_escalation_run.py` (step 4) has two branches — the all-null pre-selectio
recommendations.body: `_persist_interruption()` in `plan_tool/roadmap_escalation_run.py` (step 4) has two branches — the all-null pre-selection `interrupted` preflight, and its own `except Exception` telemetry-unavailable fallback — that no test in `tests/test_roadmap_escalation_run.py` reaches, though the detail names both (`test_interruption_records_phase_correct_lifecycle_and_null_identity`, `test_interruption_sink_failure_is_redacted_telemetry_unavailable`)
recommendations.suggested_action: add tests interrupting inside `_resolve_preflight` before any preflight append, and combining that interrupt with a sink failure during `_persist_interruption`'s own recovery append

recommendations.title: `_validate_roadmap_escalation_preflight_facts()` in `plan_tool/run_log.py` has no test proving it rejects a monotonicity
recommendations.body: `_validate_roadmap_escalation_preflight_facts()` in `plan_tool/run_log.py` has no test proving it rejects a monotonicity violation (e.g. `reason` set without a resolved selector) — every existing caller in `tests/test_run_log.py` and `tests/test_roadmap_escalation_run.py` only ever supplies already-consistent field combinations
recommendations.suggested_action: add a parametrized `pytest.raises(ValueError)` test in `tests/test_run_log.py` covering representative violations of each guarded shape
